title: Exception, privacy requirements.
bodyText: The provision of separate facilities or schedules for female and for male patrons, does not constitute a discriminatory practice when such separate facilities or schedules for female and for male patrons are bona fide requirements to protect personal rights of privacy.
bodyHtml: [§489-4]  Exception, privacy requirements.  The provision of separate facilities or schedules for female and for male patrons, does not constitute a discriminatory practice when such separate facilities or schedules for female and for male patrons are bona fide requirements to protect personal rights of privacy. [L 1986, c 292, pt of §1]
